name: Homolovi State Park

fees.note: Non-electric sites $30 a night April 15 to November 14 and $25 the rest of the year; electric $35 March 15 to November 14 and $40 the rest of the year (the fee schedule's seasons). Most sites have water and 30-amp electric (pull-throughs 30/50); 9 are non-electric; back-in and pull-through sites take large rigs. Plus the $3.60 reservation fee; a second vehicle is $15 a night. Park entry included. Arizona State Parks' fee schedule and the park's camping page, read 2026-10-12.

name: Catalina State Park

fees.note: Campgrounds A and B: every site has 20/30/50-amp electric and water, $50 a night. Ringtail Campground (overflow, no hookups) is $25, open January 1 to March 31 only. Plus the $3.60 reservation fee; a second vehicle is $15 a night. Park entry included. Arizona State Parks' fee schedule and the park's camping page, read 2026-10-12.

name: Dead Horse Ranch State Park

fees.note: Electric sites (30/50-amp, water) $50 a night; the $25 non-electric sites are the Blackhawk Loop, 'reserved exclusively for tents. RVs, including campers and vans, are not permitted.' Plus the $3.60 reservation fee; a second vehicle is $15 a night. Park entry included. Arizona State Parks' fee schedule and the park's camping page, read 2026-10-12.

name: Fool Hollow Lake Recreation Area

fees.note: 62 electric RV sites (30-amp, some 50; water at all sites, sewer in the Mallard and Redhead loops), $50 a night; oversized sites $75. The $25 non-hookup sites are tent only ('RVs are not allowed'). Plus the $3.60 reservation fee; a second vehicle is $15 a night. Park entry included. Arizona State Parks' fee schedule and the park's camping page, read 2026-10-12.

name: Cattail Cove State Park

fees.note: Every site has electric and water (the upper campground's 78 have full hookups), $50 a night. Two-night minimum for Friday-Saturday April 1 to September 30; three nights on Memorial Day, Labor Day and Columbus Day weekends. Plus the $3.60 reservation fee; a second vehicle is $15 a night. Park entry included. Arizona State Parks' fee schedule and the park's camping page, read 2026-10-12.

Arizona State Parks' fee schedule and the park's camping page, read 2026-10-12.
